content:
molly-finance: Heads up — noticed ~$12.3k in GPU charges last month tagged to product teams but traced to the `sandbox-qa` cluster. Looks like shared test VMs weren’t being excluded from team cost allocation :eyes:
harry-ops: Oof. Is that untagged spend or mis-tagged?
jess-eng: Do you have the invoice lines? I can grab the raw export and run a join with our cluster tags.
molly-finance: Billing export shows project `redwood-sandbox-prodtest` with labels absent. Some runs were spot instances w/ short lifetimes. I suspect CI jobs that spin up GPUs under a generic service account.
anita-platform: That service account is used by a bunch of test harnesses. We were supposed to add `cost_center` tags last quarter but rollout stalled.
billing-bot: [automated] New billing export available: gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-03/billing-2026-03.csv.gz
molly-finance: Thanks @billing-bot. @jess-eng can you run a quick SQL to attribute by `resource.labels.instance_id` and map to team via `inventory.instances`? If we can backfill for March, we can credit the affected teams.
jess-eng: On it. Running a one-off join now. SQL snippet I'm using:
```
SELECT b.line_item_id, b.cost, i.tag_team
FROM billing_export b
LEFT JOIN inventory.instances i ON b.instance_id = i.instance_id
WHERE b.service = 'GPU' AND b.month = '2026-03' AND (i.tag_team IS NULL OR i.tag_team = 'sandbox')
```
harry-ops: Once we confirm, ops can create a reimbursement ledger and credit the product teams. Also recommend a short-term fix: deny cloud-runs for that service account or force required labels on instance creation.
anita-platform: I can push a policy tomorrow to enforce `cost_center` on VM create with org policy. But we should also add an alert to finance when monthly untagged GPU > $1k.
molly-finance: Agreed. Action items: (1) @jess-eng produce mapping + list of instance IDs by team (due EOD), (2) @anita-platform enable label enforcement + create alert (due 48h), (3) finance will prepare credits once mapping confirmed.
jess-eng: Got the mapping — 47 instances, total $12,320. Uploaded CSV to DLP-safe bucket: gs://redwood-finance/allocations/1923456789-sandbox-backfill.csv (restricted).
anita-platform: Policy PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/platform/pulls/412 — adds label enforcement and a terraform check. Also created Cloud Monitoring alerting policy: `billing/untagged_gpu_threshold` set to $1k monthly.
molly-finance: Perfect. Please tag the PRs and alert here when merged. I'll schedule the reimbursements once I get the final confirm from @jess-eng. Thanks all :thumbsup:
harry-ops: Quick note — for future prevention, recommend adding a CI guard: on GPU requests, require `--labels=cost_center=...` or fail. I can add a small wrapper script.
jess-eng: I'll add it to the CI image and include a fallback that annotates the job run with team if label missing.
molly-finance: Closing the loop — will post the reimbursement confirmation in this thread when done. If anything pops up, ping me.
